title: Memory corruption in Autofill in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary…
description: A memory corruption vulnerability exists in the Autofill component of Google Chrome versions prior to 156.0.8078.79. This flaw allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code within the browser's sandbox by crafting a malicious HTML page. The vulnerability is classified with high severity by Chromium security.
